what_worked.description: Tile-based 4K upscaling preserves micro-zari thread pinstripes without hallucinating spurious geometry
Denoise factor between 0.18 - 0.25 sharpens embroidery beads while keeping underlying base silhouette locked

what_failed.failure_mode: Over-sharpening causing sequin reflection artifacts (sparkle halos)
what_failed.root_cause: Excessive high-frequency contrast boosting on reflective metallic elements

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Clamp denoise factor to max 0.25 and suppress artificial sharpening halos on metallic textures
